description: With +speculative-mtp and PP > 1: load the MTP draft with the standard safetensors loader. Only the last pipeline stage loads the draft, and the Run:ai streamer starts a collective over all ranks, so with it the last stage waits for the other stages until the 10-minute store timeout. vLLM 0.31 makes this switch itself only for fastsafetensors (get_pp_safe_draft_load_config). The target model still uses the platform loader.
